referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Mining process, transport to beneficiation plant, dry processing including crushing, screening or washing and flotation.Drying orcalcination of washed rock included. Land use for mining and reclamation.
referenceFunction.localName: Phosphate rock, as P2O5, beneficiated, dry, at plant
referenceFunction.name: Phosphate rock, as P2O5, beneficiated, dry, at plant

geography.text: Assumption for production in Morocco based mainly on data from Florida. Some data from Moroccan mines. Various processes with location RER used.

technology.text: U.S. technology for dry rock or dried wet rock processing. Average technology mix modelled. No specific age of technology modelled

timePeriod.text: Time of literature publication. Measurements took place partly before this period.

representativeness.extrapolations: Extrapolation and transformation from U.S. data with help of specific informations from literature on Moroccan mines. No extrapolation for energy data.
representativeness.productionVolume: 7.2 Mt as P2O5 in 2000, 21.6 Mt as Rock in 2000
representativeness.samplingProcedure: Data for emissions and land use based on various studies from Florida. Energy data based on a world-wide survey and some assumptions. Further data from Moroccan studies, literature and estimations.
